log: Act III, W5: the night wood; a run from here has no Act I, II or morning behind it
the small light on the path before the glade: it burns on the ground and does not move
a tree whose bark glows matt green
the rotten log in the corner of the glade: a piece broken from it, taken with the first answer
she sits down beside the lantern, on its east side: the cue tells the silence, then it hums once
she sits on; nothing runs on a clock
a step gets her up again; nothing was locked
the last stretch before the door: the trunks stand apart, the path grows wide
the door at the end of the path: nothing locked it, and the brook is the valley's
